stem.text: Propanone reacts with an aqueous mixture of $\text{HCN}$ and $\text{NaCN}$ by a nucleophilic addition mechanism.
The first stage of the mechanism involves attack by cyanide ions.

A.alt: Mechanism: N≡C: with negative charge on carbon, linked by a straight arrow whose head points at the cyanide (away from the carbonyl carbon) from the carbon of propanone; curly arrow on the C=O towards O; delta+ on carbon, delta- on oxygen.

B.alt: Mechanism: N≡C: with negative charge on carbon, linked by a straight arrow whose head points at the cyanide (away from the carbonyl carbon) from the carbon of propanone; curly arrow on the C=O; delta+ on carbon, delta- on oxygen.

C.alt: Mechanism: C≡N: with negative charge on nitrogen, straight arrow from the nitrogen end to the delta+ carbonyl carbon of propanone; curly arrow on the C=O towards O; delta- on oxygen.

D.alt: Mechanism: N≡C: with negative charge on carbon, straight arrow from the carbon end to the delta+ carbonyl carbon of propanone; curly arrow on the C=O towards O; delta- on oxygen.
